page.overview:
Who is Candy Cane Girl?

Candy Cane Girl is the gender-swapped version of Candy Cane Guy, who appears in the episode "Fionna and Cake" at the Biennial Gumball Ball, and in the alternate title sequence. She is shown as a very minor background character. She is seen dancing with Gumdrop Lad 1.

She is a red-and-white-striped candy cane with a fedora that has a yellow flower. In the title sequence of "Fionna and Cake," she wears a tight-fitting brown shirt. At the Gumball Ball, however, it is missing.
